traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Alseuosmiaceae: leaves alternate or whorled; leaves simple; margins dentate or entire; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite or polygamous; ovary half inferior or inferior; floral cup present or absent; joined corolla urceolate or funnelform; stems woody; flowers solitary or in racemes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit berry; parts of each whorl (4-) 5 (-7); stamens (4-) 5 (-7); carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
